latest_release.name: v3.5.0
latest_release.body:
Umami `v3.5.0` adds **browser error tracking**, improved replay navigation, and fixes across tracking, reporting, and sharing.

## New features

### Browser error tracking

Capture JavaScript errors alongside your analytics and investigate affected visits.

- Automatically capture uncaught exceptions and unhandled promise rejections with `data-errors="true"`
- Capture handled errors with `umami.captureException()`
- Group errors into issues with stack traces, occurrence counts, and session details
- Resolve, ignore, and reopen issues
- Search and filter by release, environment, browser, and page path

### Replays and navigation

- Previous/next replay controls with left/right arrow keyboard shortcuts
- Distinct visitor IDs in replay lists
- Team websites available in the website switcher outside a team
- Dashboard access from mobile navigation

### Tracking and preferences

- Configure the tracker and recorder through `window.umamiConfig`, with script attributes taking precedence
- Optional client-provided session salts and hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly tracker salt rotation, enabled server-side with `ENABLE_CLIENT_SALT`
- Expanded server-side `SALT_ROTATION` options, including fixed salts
- `TRUSTED_PROXIES` configuration for client IP detection behind multiple proxies
- A 12/24-hour clock preference

## Reporting improvements

- Click a website chart bar to zoom into its date range
- Select custom date ranges in a single two-month calendar
- Compare an ongoing period against the equivalent elapsed portion of the previous period
- Improved comparison chart alignment, timezone handling, and daylight-saving transitions
- Retention cell shading relative to the highest visible value
- Session referrers in Session Overview and active visitor indicators in the realtime log
- Faster attribution, funnel, and paginated queries

## Security

- Require changing the seeded administrator password before continuing
- Enforce required two-factor enrollment on the server and harden verification against concurrent attempts and code reuse
- Revalidate share tokens against current share settings so deletion and permission changes take effect
- Restrict board shares from exposing raw event, session, revenue, and realtime activity data
- Tighten team permissions, password updates, and API key route checks
- Validate link destinations and collection input more strictly

## Fixes

- Session resets, identity attribution, and concurrent anonymous-session claims
- Redis-backed login sessions expiring during active use
- Stale website, link, and pixel caches after updates or deletion
- Background-tab and prerendered-page performance measurements
- Heatmap overlays in Safari, snapshot sizing, and tracking inside preview frames
- Retention cohort dates, full-month navigation, and invalid custom date selections
- Search text being overwritten by delayed navigation
- Custom wildcard selections and missing values in negative filters
- Board ownership when transferring websites
- Docker/Podman server binding
- Translation, accessibility, and responsive layout issues

## API updates

- Optional `period` parameters on analytics endpoints, including `today`, `24h`, `7d`, and `30d`
- `visitId` in website event responses
- New error tracking endpoints and refreshed API client types
- Corrected event-filter handling in MCP tools

## Upgrade notes

- **`APP_SECRET` must be set explicitly.** Falling back to `DATABASE_URL` is no longer supported.
- Node.js **20.19+** is required; Node.js 22 LTS is recommended.
- Password changes are now under **Settings → Security**.
- The public `/api/config` endpoint has been removed.

This release includes database migrations:

- PostgreSQL: `27_add_error_tracking`

**Full Changelog:** [v3.4.1…v3.5.0](https://github.com/umami-software/umami/compare/v3.4.1...v3.5.0)
